O.outcome_detail: association with formal versus informal learning context; gamification was more prevalent in formal contexts

cells.quote: Gamification was overwhelmingly tied to formal contexts (85.29%; 95% CI [69.87%, 93.55%]; see Figure 4) and only rarely in informal environments (14.71%; 95% CI [6.45%, 30.12%]; see Figure 4). In contrast, GBL approaches were more evenly distributed across formal (45.90%; 95% CI [34.01%, 58.28%]; see Figure 4) and informal (54.10%; 95% CI [41.72%, 65.99%]; see Figure 4) settings. This overall association between approach and context was statistically significant. with 𝜒 2(1)= 14.16, 𝑝< 0.001, Cramer’s V = 0.37, OR = 6.84 (95% CI [2.33, 20.02]), and RR = 1.86 (95% CI [1.37, 2.52]).
cells.note: This is a review-level association between instructional approach and learning context, not evidence that gamification causes better learning outcomes.
